generation_rule: Compose 36 original instrumental Lofi Hip Hop tracks from text only. No existing recordings, copyrighted melodies, third-party samples or reference audio may be used. Maintain a cohesive jazzy boom-bap sound while making every intro, chord progression, melody, groove, instrumentation and arrangement clearly different.
diversity_policy: Compare 45-second beginnings of each produced song against every approved track in this playlist. Reject overly similar intros and regenerate a structurally different arrangement.
